Loi de Bernoulli\n","\n","La loi de Bernoulli modélise une expérience aléatoire qui a exactement deux résultats possibles (succès (S) ou échec (E). La probabilité de succès est $p$. C'est un cas particulier de la loi binomiale avec $n=1$ essai."]},{"cell_type":"markdown","source":[],"metadata":{"id":"L610fJQeBr49"}},{"cell_type":"code","metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":546},"id":"bf7ce201","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1790431891635,"user_tz":240,"elapsed":1004,"user":{"displayName":"Zyed (probabilité de succès)\n","p = 0.7\n","\n","# Création de la distribution de Bernoulli\n","bernoulli_dist = stats.bernoulli(p)\n","\n","# Calcul de la PMF (Probability Mass Function)\n","# P(X=0) = probabilité d'échec\n","# P(X=1) = probabilité de succès\n","prob_echec = bernoulli_dist.pmf(0)\n","prob_succes = bernoulli_dist.pmf(1)\n","\n","print(f\"Probabilité d'échec (X=0): {prob_echec:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Probabilité de succès (X=1): {prob_succes:.2f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de l'espérance, de la médiane et de la variance\n","esperance_bernoulli = bernoulli_dist.mean()\n","mediane_bernoulli = bernoulli_dist.median()\n","variance_bernoulli = bernoulli_dist.var()\n","\n","print(f\"\\nEspérance (E[X]): {esperance_bernoulli:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Médiane: {mediane_bernoulli:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Variance (Var[X]): {variance_bernoulli:.2f}\")\n","\n","# Génération d'échantillons aléatoires\n","echantillons_bernoulli = bernoulli_dist.rvs(size=10)\n","print(f\"\\nÉchantillons de Bernoulli: {echantillons_bernoulli}\")\n","\n","# Visualisation de la PMF (Probability Mass Function/Probabilité ponctuelle pour une v.a. discrète)\n","plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))\n","plt.bar([0, 1], [prob_echec, prob_succes], tick_label=['Échec', 'Succès'])\n","plt.title('Loi de Bernoulli (p=0.7)')\n","plt.xlabel('Résultat')\n","plt.ylabel('Probabilité')\n","plt.show()"],"execution_count":null,"outputs":[{"output_type":"stream","name":"stdout","text":["Probabilité d'échec (X=0): Ben Salah","userId":"17801988142866648191"}},"outputId":"8ff61aee-09ec-4c97-d3c3-bb9b42b830fc"},"source":["import numpy as np\n","# Définir différentes combinaisons de n et p à visualiser\n","params = [\n","    {'n': 10, 'p': 0.2},\n","    {'n': 10, 'p': 0.5},\n","    {'n': 10, 'p': 0.8},\n","    {'n': 20, 'p': 0.5},\n","    {'n': 50, 'p': 0.1}\n","]\n","\n","plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))\n","\n","for i, param in enumerate(params):\n","    n = param['n']\n","    p = param['p']\n","\n","    # Création de la distribution Binomiale\n","    binomial_dist = stats.binom(n=n, p=p)\n","\n","    # Valeurs possibles de k (nombre de succès)\n","    k_values = np.arange(0, n + 1)\n","    pmf_values = binomial_dist.pmf(k_values)\n","\n","    # Créer un sous-graphique pour chaque Loi de Poisson\n","\n","La loi de Poisson modélise le nombre d'événements se produisant dans un intervalle de temps ou d'espace fixe, si ces événements se produisent avec un taux moyen constant et indépendamment du temps écoulé depuis le dernier événement. Le seul paramètre est $\\lambda$ (lambda), le taux moyen d'événements."]},{"cell_type":"code","metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":567},"id":"ba4866f8","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1790433074833,"user_tz":240,"elapsed":159,"user":{"displayName":"Zyed Ben Salah","userId":"17801988142866648191"}},"outputId":"cd7930a7-c356-4abc-e3b6-5e50b5d8039c"},"source":["# Paramètre lambda (taux moyen d'événements)\n","lambda_poisson = 3\n","\n","# Création de la distribution de Poisson\n","poisson_dist = stats.poisson(mu=lambda_poisson)\n","\n","# Calcul de la PMF\n","k_val = 2\n","prob_k_events = poisson_dist.pmf(k_val)\n","print(f\"Probabilité d'observer {k_val} événements: {prob_k_events:.4f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de la CDF (Cumulative Distribution Function/Fonction cumulée de répartition)\n","prob_at_most_k_events = poisson_dist.cdf(k_val)\n","print(f\"Probabilité d'observer au plus {k_val} événements: {prob_at_most_k_events:.4f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de l'espérance, de la médiane et de la variance\n","esperance_poisson = poisson_dist.mean()\n","mediane_poisson = poisson_dist.median()\n","variance_poisson = poisson_dist.var()\n","\n","print(f\"\\nEspérance (E[X]): {esperance_poisson:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Médiane: {mediane_poisson:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Variance (Var[X]): {variance_poisson:.2f}\")\n","\n","# Génération d'échantillons aléatoires\n","echantillons_poisson = poisson_dist.rvs(size=100)\n","print(f\"\\nÉchantillons de la loi de Poisson (premiers 10): {echantillons_poisson[:10]}\")\n","\n","# Visualisation de la PMF\n","k_values = np.arange(0, 10) # Afficher jusqu'à un certain nombre d'événements\n","pmf_values = poisson_dist.pmf(k_values)\n","\n","plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n","plt.bar(k_values, pmf_values)\n","plt.title(f'Loi de Poisson (lambda={lambda_poisson})')\n","plt.xlabel('Nombre d\\'événements (k)')\n","plt.ylabel('Probabilité')\n","plt.xticks(k_values)\n","plt.show()"],"execution_count":null,"outputs":[{"output_type":"stream","name":"stdout","text":["Probabilité d'observer 2 événements: 0.2240\n","Probabilité d'observer au plus 2 événements: 0.4232\n","\n","Espérance (E[X]): 3.00\n","Médiane: 3.00\n","Variance (Var[X]): 3.00\n","\n","Échantillons de la loi de Poisson (premiers 10): [4 2 5 4 4 3 2 2 4 2]\n"]},{"output_type":"display_data","data":{"text/plain":["<Figure size 800x500 with 1 Axes>"],"image/png":"\n"},"metadata":{}}]},{"cell_type":"markdown","metadata":{"id":"21dfbbea"},"source":["### 4. Loi Uniforme (Continue)\n","\n","La loi uniforme continue modélise des événements où tous les résultats dans un intervalle donné $[a, b]$ sont également probables. Sa fonction de densité de probabilité (PDF) est constante sur cet intervalle."]},{"cell_type":"code","metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":1000},"id":"be65c367","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1790433108946,"user_tz":240,"elapsed":371,"user":{"displayName":"Zyed Ben Salah","userId":"17801988142866648191"}},"outputId":"8271fdcc-d457-4081-a60a-82ac30e3f95a"},"source":["# Paramètres a (borne inférieure) et b (borne supérieure)\n","a_uniforme = 0\n","b_uniforme = 10\n","\n","# Création de la distribution Uniforme\n","# `loc` est la borne inférieure, `scale` est la longueur de l'intervalle (b-a)\n","uniform_dist = stats.uniform(loc=a_uniforme, scale=b_uniforme - a_uniforme)\n","\n","# Calcul de la PDF (Probability Density Function)\n","x_val = 5\n","pdf_val = uniform_dist.pdf(x_val)\n","print(f\"Densité de probabilité à x={x_val}: {pdf_val:.2f} (constante sur l'intervalle)\")\n","\n","# Calcul de la CDF (Cumulative Distribution Function)\n","# P(X <= x) = probabilité que la variable soit inférieure ou égale à x\n","cdf_val = uniform_dist.cdf(x_val)\n","print(f\"Probabilité P(X <= {x_val}): {cdf_val:.2f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de la probabilité d'un intervalle P(x1 <= X <= x2)\n","x1 = 2\n","x2 = 7\n","prob_interval = uniform_dist.cdf(x2) - uniform_dist.cdf(x1)\n","print(f\"Probabilité P({x1} <= X <= {x2}): {prob_interval:.2f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de l'espérance, de la médiane et de la variance\n","esperance_uniforme = uniform_dist.mean()\n","mediane_uniforme = uniform_dist.median()\n","variance_uniforme = uniform_dist.var()\n","\n","print(f\"\\nEspérance (E[X]): {esperance_uniforme:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Médiane: {mediane_uniforme:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Variance (Var[X]): {variance_uniforme:.2f}\")\n","\n","# Génération d'échantillons aléatoires\n","echantillons_uniforme = uniform_dist.rvs(size=1000)\n","print(f\"\\nÉchantillons de la loi Uniforme (premiers 10): {echantillons_uniforme[:10]}\")\n","\n","# Visualisation de la PDF\n","x = np.linspace(a_uniforme - 1, b_uniforme + 1, 500)\n","y_pdf = uniform_dist.pdf(x)\n","\n","plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n","plt.plot(x, y_pdf, label='PDF')\n","plt.fill_between(x, 0, y_pdf, alpha=0.3)\n","plt.title(f'Loi Uniforme (a={a_uniforme}, b={b_uniforme})')\n","plt.xlabel('Valeur')\n","plt.ylabel('Densité de Probabilité')\n","plt.ylim(0, pdf_val * 1.5)\n","plt.show()\n","\n","# Histogramme des échantillons avec matplotlib\n","plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n","plt.hist(echantillons_uniforme, bins=20, density=True, alpha=0.6, color='g', label='Histogramme des échantillons')\n","plt.title('Histogramme des échantillons de la loi Uniforme')\n","plt.xlabel('Valeur')\n","plt.ylabel('Densité')\n","plt.legend()\n","plt.show()\n"],"execution_count":null,"outputs":[{"output_type":"stream","name":"stdout","text":["Densité de probabilité à x=5: 0.10 (constante sur l'intervalle)\n","Probabilité P(X <= 5): 0.50\n","Probabilité P(2 <= X <= 7): 0.50\n","\n","Espérance (E[X]): 5.00\n","Médiane: 5.00\n","Variance (Var[X]): 8.33\n","\n","Échantillons de la loi Uniforme (premiers 10): [8.91928932 3.71903911 4.7320505  0.71914032 0.35231583 9.69706951\n"," 0.27317327 4.27741389 2.86977666 9.6010463 ]\n"]},{"output_type":"display_data","data":{"text/plain":["<Figure size 800x500 with 1 Axes>"],"image/png":"\n"},"metadata":{}},{"output_type":"display_data","data":{"text/plain":["<Figure size 800x500 with 1 Axes>"],"image/png":"\n"},"metadata":{}}]},{"cell_type":"markdown","metadata":{"id":"db1dad46"},"source":["### 5. Loi Exponentielle\n","\n","La loi exponentielle modélise le temps entre des événements consécutifs dans un processus de Poisson (c'est-à-dire des événements se produisant à un taux moyen constant). Son paramètre est $\\lambda$ (lambda), le taux d'événements. Dans `scipy.stats`, elle est souvent paramétrée par `scale` qui est l'inverse de $\\lambda$ ($1/\\lambda$, la moyenne)."]},{"cell_type":"code","metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":1000},"id":"edabb3c5","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1790433192769,"user_tz":240,"elapsed":369,"user":{"displayName":"Zyed Ben Salah","userId":"17801988142866648191"}},"outputId":"c288ea21-cc58-4a09-e522-91a7e3e52313"},"source":["# Paramètre lambda (taux d'événements)\n","lambda_exponentielle = 0.5 # Signifie en moyenne 0.5 événement par unité de temps (ou 1 événement toutes les 2 unités de temps)\n","\n","# Dans scipy.stats, `scale` est l'inverse de lambda (1/lambda)\n","scale_exponentielle = 1 / lambda_exponentielle\n","\n","# Création de la distribution Exponentielle\n","exponential_dist = stats.expon(scale=scale_exponentielle)\n","\n","# Calcul de la PDF\n","x_val = 2\n","pdf_val = exponential_dist.pdf(x_val)\n","print(f\"Densité de probabilité à x={x_val}: {pdf_val:.4f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de la CDF\n","# P(X <= x) = probabilité que le temps d'attente soit inférieur ou égal à x\n","cdf_val = exponential_dist.cdf(x_val)\n","print(f\"Probabilité P(X <= {x_val}): {cdf_val:.4f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de la probabilité d'un intervalle P(x1 <= X <= x2)\n","x1 = 1\n","x2 = 4\n","prob_interval = exponential_dist.cdf(x2) - exponential_dist.cdf(x1)\n","print(f\"Probabilité P({x1} <= X <= {x2}): {prob_interval:.4f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de l'espérance, de la médiane et de la variance\n","esperance_exponentielle = exponential_dist.mean()\n","mediane_exponentielle = exponential_dist.median()\n","variance_exponentielle = exponential_dist.var()\n","\n","print(f\"\\nEspérance (E[X]): {esperance_exponentielle:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Médiane: {mediane_exponentielle:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Variance (Var[X]): {variance_exponentielle:.2f}\")\n","\n","# Génération d'échantillons aléatoires\n","echantillons_exponentielle = exponential_dist.rvs(size=1000)\n","print(f\"\\nÉchantillons de la loi Exponentielle (premiers 10): {echantillons_exponentielle[:10]}\")\n","\n","# Visualisation de la PDF\n","x = np.linspace(0, 10, 500)\n","y_pdf = exponential_dist.pdf(x)\n","\n","plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n","plt.plot(x, y_pdf, label='PDF')\n","plt.fill_between(x, 0, y_pdf, alpha=0.3)\n","plt.title(f'Loi Exponentielle (lambda={lambda_exponentielle})')\n","plt.xlabel('Temps d\\'attente')\n","plt.ylabel('Densité de Probabilité')\n","plt.show()\n","\n","# Histogramme des échantillons avec matplotlib\n","plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n","plt.hist(echantillons_exponentielle, bins=30, density=True, alpha=0.6, color='g', label='Histogramme des échantillons')\n","plt.title('Histogramme des échantillons de la loi Exponentielle')\n","plt.xlabel('Temps d\\'attente')\n","plt.ylabel('Densité')\n","plt.legend()\n","plt.show()"],"execution_count":null,"outputs":[{"output_type":"stream","name":"stdout","text":["Densité de probabilité à x=2: Loi Normale\n","\n","La loi normale (ou gaussienne) est l'une des distributions de probabilité les plus importantes. Elle est caractérisée par sa forme en cloche et est définie par deux paramètres : sa moyenne ($\\mu$) et son écart type ($\\sigma$).\n","\n","Dans `scipy.stats`, la moyenne est `loc` et l'écart type est `scale`."]},{"cell_type":"code","metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":1000},"id":"d75c9f6d","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1790347465383,"user_tz":240,"elapsed":371,"user":{"displayName":"Zyed Ben Salah","userId":"17801988142866648191"}},"outputId":"89bb2833-6523-4c56-ab9e-dde31c158c4d"},"source":["# Paramètres mu (moyenne) et sigma (écart type)\n","mu_normale = 0\n","sigma_normale = 1 # Loi normale standard\n","\n","# Création de la distribution Normale\n","normal_dist = stats.norm(loc=mu_normale, scale=sigma_normale)\n","\n","# Calcul de la PDF\n","x_val = 0.5\n","pdf_val = normal_dist.pdf(x_val)\n","print(f\"Densité de probabilité à x={x_val}: {pdf_val:.4f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de la CDF\n","# P(X <= x) = probabilité que la variable soit inférieure ou égale à x\n","cdf_val = normal_dist.cdf(x_val)\n","print(f\"Probabilité P(X <= {x_val}): {cdf_val:.4f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de la probabilité d'un intervalle P(x1 <= X <= x2)\n","x1 = -1\n","x2 = 1\n","prob_interval = normal_dist.cdf(x2) - normal_dist.cdf(x1)\n","print(f\"Probabilité P({x1} <= X <= {x2}) (environ 68% pour la loi normale standard): {prob_interval:.4f}\")\n","\n","# Calcul de l'espérance, de la médiane et de la variance\n","esperance_normale = normal_dist.mean()\n","mediane_normale = normal_dist.median()\n","variance_normale = normal_dist.var()\n","\n","print(f\"\\nEspérance (E[X]): {esperance_normale:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Médiane: {mediane_normale:.2f}\")\n","print(f\"Variance (Var[X]): {variance_normale:.2f}\")\n","\n","# Génération d'échantillons aléatoires\n","echantillons_normale = normal_dist.rvs(size=1000)\n","print(f\"\\nÉchantillons de la loi Normale (premiers 10): {echantillons_normale[:10]}\")\n","\n","# Visualisation de la PDF\n","x = np.linspace(-4, 4, 500)\n","y_pdf = normal_dist.pdf(x)\n","\n","plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n","plt.plot(x, y_pdf, label='PDF')\n","plt.fill_between(x, 0, y_pdf, alpha=0.3)\n","plt.title(f'Loi Normale (mu={mu_normale}, sigma={sigma_normale})')\n","plt.xlabel('Valeur')\n","plt.ylabel('Densité de Probabilité')\n","plt.show()\n","\n","# Histogramme des échantillons avec matplotlib\n","plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n","plt.hist(echantillons_normale, bins=30, density=True, alpha=0.6, color='g', label='Histogramme des échantillons')\n","plt.title('Histogramme des échantillons de la loi Normale')\n","plt.xlabel('Valeur')\n","plt.ylabel('Densité')\n","plt.legend()\n","plt.show()"],"execution_count":null,"outputs":[{"output_type":"stream","name":"stdout","text":["Densité de probabilité Théorèmes Limites (résultats asymptotiques):\n"," Vérification de la Loi Forte des Grands Nombres (LFGN) et du Théorème Central Limite (TCL)\n","\n","Cette section illustre de manière empirique deux théorèmes fondamentaux :\n","\n","* **La Loi Forte des Grands Nombres** : La moyenne d'un grand nombre de variables aléatoires indépendantes et identiquement distribuées converge presque sûrement vers leur espérance mathématique.\n","* **Le Théorème Central Limite** : La distribution de la somme (ou la moyenne) de $N$ variables indépendantes s'approche de plus en plus d'une distribution normale à mesure que  $N$ est d plus en plus grand ( quelle que soit la loi de départ)."]},{"cell_type":"markdown","metadata":{"id":"1a228092"},"source":["#### A. Illustration de la Loi Forte des Grands Nombres\n","\n","Nous allons simuler des lancers d'un dé équilibré à 6 faces. L'espérance théorique d'un dé à 6 faces est :\n","$$E[X] = \\frac{1+2+3+4+5+6}{6} = 3.5$$"]},{"cell_type":"code","metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":506},"id":"3930e308","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1791296509472,"user_tz":240,"elapsed":423,"user":{"displayName":"Zyed Ben Salah","userId":"17801988142866648191"}},"outputId":"5d11aa30-3e84-4b95-d6ee-9eccda043cab"},"source":["import numpy as np\n","import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n","\n","# Fixer la graine aléatoire pour la reproductibilité\n","np.random.seed(42)\n","\n","# Nombre total de lancers\n","n_lancers = 5000\n","\n","# Simulation des lancers (valeurs de 1 à 6)\n","lancers = np.random.randint(1, 7, size=n_lancers)\n","\n","# Calcul de la moyenne cumulée\n","moyennes_cumulees = np.cumsum(lancers) / np.arange(1, n_lancers + 1)\n","\n","# Tracé du graphique\n","plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n","plt.plot(moyennes_cumulees, label='Moyenne empirique cumulée', color='blue')\n","plt.axhline(y=3.5, color='red', linestyle='--', label='Espérance théorique (3.5)')\n","plt.title('Vérification de la Loi Forte des Grands Nombres (Lancers de dé)')\n","plt.xlabel('Nombre de lancers (n)')\n","plt.ylabel('Moyenne')\n","plt.legend()\n","plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n","plt.show()"],"execution_count":1,"outputs":[{"output_type":"display_data","data":{"text/plain":["<Figure size 1000x600 with 1 Axes>"],"image/png":"\n"},"metadata":{}}]},{"cell_type":"markdown","metadata":{"id":"0c933a8e"},"source":["#### B. Illustration du Théorème Central Limite\n","\n","Nous allons générer des échantillons à partir d'une distribution très asymétrique (la **loi exponentielle**), puis calculer la moyenne de ces échantillons pour différentes tailles $N$. Vous verrez que plus $N$ augmente, plus la distribution des moyennes d'échantillons ressemble à une loi normale.\n","\n","**Question**\n","Quelle est la distribution approximative de $$X_1+X_2+\\cdots X_{N}$$\n","lorsque les $(X_i)$ sont i.i.d. qui suivent la loi exponentielle de paramètre $2$.\n","\n","**Réponse**"]},{"cell_type":"code","metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":518},"id":"b10001af","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1791296576792,"user_tz":240,"elapsed":1904,"user":{"displayName":"Zyed Ben Salah","userId":"17801988142866648191"}},"outputId":"4e802e69-4e5c-4b44-b2bd-e25d6f559173"},"source":["import numpy as np\n","from scipy import stats\n","import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n","\n","# Paramètres de simulation\n","# Loi d'origine : Exponentielle avec scale (moyenne) = 2\n","scale_exp = 2\n","\n","# Nombre de simulations (le nombre de moyennes que l'on va calculer pour tracer l'histogramme)\n","n_simulations = 2000\n","\n","# Tailles d'échantillon à tester\n","tailles_echantillon = [2, 10, 50, 200]\n","\n","plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))\n","\n","for i, N in enumerate(tailles_echantillon):\n","    # Générer une matrice d'échantillons (n_simulations lignes, N colonnes)\n","    echantillons = np.random.exponential(scale=scale_exp, size=(n_simulations, N))\n","\n","    # Calculer la moyenne pour chaque échantillon (le long de l'axe des colonnes)\n","    moyennes = np.mean(echantillons, axis=1)\n","\n","    # Créer un sous-graphique\n","    plt.subplot(2, 2, i + 1)\n","\n","    # Tracer l'histogramme des moyennes empiriques\n","    plt.hist(moyennes, bins=40, density=True, alpha=0.6, color='emerald' if 'emerald' in globals() else 'skyblue', edgecolor='black')\n","\n","    # Superposer la courbe normale théorique prédite par le TCL :\n","    # Moyenne des moyennes = espérance de la loi d'origine = scale_exp\n","    # Écart-type des moyennes = écart-type d'origine / sqrt(N) = scale_exp / sqrt(N)\n","    mu_tcl = scale_exp\n","    sigma_tcl = scale_exp / np.sqrt(N)\n","\n","    x = np.linspace(min(moyennes), max(moyennes), 100)\n","    pdf_normal = stats.norm.pdf(x, loc=mu_tcl, scale=sigma_tcl)\n","    plt.plot(x, pdf_normal, 'r-', lw=2, label='Normalisation théorique (TCL)')\n","\n","    plt.title(f'Moyennes d\\u2019échantillons de taille N = {N}')\n","    plt.xlabel('Moyenne d\\u2019échantillon')\n","    plt.ylabel('Densité')\n","    plt.legend()\n","    plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n","\n","plt.suptitle('Théorème Central Limite (Loi exponentielle de départ)', fontsize=16, y=0.98)\n","plt.tight_layout()\n","plt.show()"],"execution_count":2,"outputs":[{"output_type":"display_data","data":{"text/plain":["<Figure size 1500x1000 with 4 Axes>"],"image/png":"\n"},"metadata":{}}]}]}
